title: 有機朗肯循環餘熱發電
titleEn: Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery
subcategoryTitleEn: Power cycles and combined heat and power
summary: 水泥窯、玻璃爐、鋼廠與燃氣壓縮站每天把大量三四百度的熱排進大氣。這個溫度拿來燒水推蒸汽渦輪效率很差，改用沸點低的有機流體——有機朗肯循環——就能把其中一兩成變成電，而且設備簡單、可以無人運轉。課程定量分析可回收的熱與發電量、相對於卡諾極限的效率、最佳的蒸發溫度、回熱器的效益、冷卻氣溫的影響、投資的回收年限與減碳量。
summaryEn: Cement kilns, glass furnaces, steelworks and gas compressor stations vent great quantities of heat at three or four hundred degrees every day. Raising steam at that temperature for a turbine is inefficient; a low-boiling organic fluid, the organic Rankine cycle, turns a tenth or two of it into power with simple plant that runs unattended. The course quantifies recoverable heat and power, efficiency against the Carnot limit, best evaporating temperature, benefit of a recuperator, effect of cooling air temperature, payback on investment and carbon saved.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

nodes: Generator and power or heat network

v30Focus: 把丟掉的熱變成電：餘熱量、第二定律效率、最佳蒸發溫度、回熱、氣溫影響與回收年限
v30FocusEn: Turning discarded heat into power: waste heat available, second-law efficiency, best evaporating temperature, recuperation, air temperature and payback

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：有機朗肯循環餘熱發電
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「可回收的餘熱與發電量」與「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Recoverable waste heat and power" and "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「可回收的餘熱與發電量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Recoverable waste heat and power" is correct?
options: 第一步是算出有多少熱可以用。
工廠的廢氣是沒有價值的廢棄物。
只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。
optionsEn: The first step is how much heat can be used.
Factory exhaust is worthless waste.
With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%.
quiz.explanation: 第一步是算出有多少熱可以用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The first step is how much heat can be used. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可回收的餘熱與發電量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Recoverable waste heat and power: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「可回收的餘熱與發電量」如何決定「有機朗肯循環餘熱發電」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Recoverable waste heat and power” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 第一步是算出有多少熱可以用。廢氣帶走的熱等於質量流量、比熱與可利用溫差的乘積。溫差的下限不是環境溫度：廢氣如果冷卻到一百多度以下，其中的硫酸與水氣會凝結而腐蝕煙道，所以通常只能降到一百五十度左右。算出來的熱功率再乘以循環的效率——在這個溫度大約百分之十八——就是能發的電。一座中型水泥窯的廢氣可以發兩 MW 上下，足以供應工廠自己一兩成的用電。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first step is how much heat can be used. Heat carried by exhaust is mass flow times specific heat times usable temperature drop. The lower bound is not ambient: cooled much below a hundred and something degrees, sulphuric acid and moisture condense and corrode the flue, so about 150 degrees is the usual limit. That thermal power times cycle efficiency, about 18 percent at this temperature, is power generated. Exhaust of a medium cement kiln gives about two megawatts, a tenth or two of the works' own demand. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：有機朗肯循環適用的熱源溫度約 100 至 400 °C
steps.observationEn: Project file: Organic Rankine cycles suit heat sources of about 100 to 400 °C
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「工廠的廢氣是沒有價值的廢棄物。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Factory exhaust is worthless waste." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「可回收的餘熱與發電量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Recoverable waste heat and power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The first step is how much heat can be used. Heat carried by exhaust is mass flow times specific heat times usable temperature drop. The lower bound is not ambient: cooled much below a hundred and something degrees, sulphuric acid and moisture condense and corrode the flue, so about 150 degrees is the usual limit. That thermal power times cycle efficiency, about 18 percent at this temperature, is power generated. Exhaust of a medium cement kiln gives about two megawatts, a tenth or two of the works' own demand.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：工廠的廢氣是沒有價值的廢棄物。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Factory exhaust is worthless waste. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 有機朗肯循環適用的熱源溫度約 100 至 400 °C
knowledge.textEn: Organic Rankine cycles suit heat sources of about 100 to 400 °C

quiz.question: 依「可回收的餘熱與發電量」的模型 P = ṁ·c_p·ΔT·η，廢氣流量 50 kg/s、比熱 1.1 kJ/(kg·K)、可利用溫差 200 K、循環效率 0.18 時的發電功率最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = ṁ·c_p·ΔT·η for "Recoverable waste heat and power", which value is closest to the power from 50 kg/s of exhaust of 1.1 kJ/(kg·K) cooled by 200 K at 0.18 cycle efficiency?
quiz.explanation: P = ṁ·c_p·ΔT·η；代入 m = 50 kg/s、cp = 1.1 kJ/(kg·K)、dT = 200 K、η = 0.18，得 1.98 MW（廢氣流量 50 kg/s、比熱 1.1 kJ/(kg·K)、可利用溫差 200 K、循環效率 0.18 時的發電功率）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = ṁ·c_p·ΔT·η; with m = 50 kg/s, cp = 1.1 kJ/(kg·K), dT = 200 K, η = 0.18 the result is 1.98 MW (power from 50 kg/s of exhaust of 1.1 kJ/(kg·K) cooled by 200 K at 0.18 cycle efficiency). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 可回收的餘熱與發電量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Recoverable waste heat and power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可回收的餘熱與發電量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Recoverable waste heat and power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = ṁ·c_p·ΔT·η；代入 m = 50 kg/s、cp = 1.1 kJ/(kg·K)、dT = 200 K、η = 0.18，得 1.98 MW（廢氣流量 50 kg/s、比熱 1.1 kJ/(kg·K)、可利用溫差 200 K、循環效率 0.18 時的發電功率）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 dT 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = ṁ·c_p·ΔT·η; with m = 50 kg/s, cp = 1.1 kJ/(kg·K), dT = 200 K, η = 0.18 the result is 1.98 MW (power from 50 kg/s of exhaust of 1.1 kJ/(kg·K) cooled by 200 K at 0.18 cycle efficiency). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise dT by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：dT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.18 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising dT by 10% changes the result to 2.18 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1.98 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 dT 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1.98 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in dT with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P = ṁ·c_p·ΔT·η；代入 m = 50 kg/s、cp = 1.1 kJ/(kg·K)、dT = 200 K、η = 0.18，得 1.98 MW（廢氣流量 50 kg/s、比熱 1.1 kJ/(kg·K)、可利用溫差 200 K、循環效率 0.18 時的發電功率）。
knowledge.textEn: P = ṁ·c_p·ΔT·η; with m = 50 kg/s, cp = 1.1 kJ/(kg·K), dT = 200 K, η = 0.18 the result is 1.98 MW (power from 50 kg/s of exhaust of 1.1 kJ/(kg·K) cooled by 200 K at 0.18 cycle efficiency).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: dT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.18 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising dT by 10% changes the result to 2.18 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可回收的餘熱與發電量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Recoverable waste heat and power"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
汽電共生的總效率有九成，表示它發電的效率也有九成。
在製程的各種負載下量測廢氣的流量、溫度與成分，建立全年的餘熱延時曲線。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A cogeneration plant with 90% total efficiency also generates electricity at 90% efficiency.
Exhaust flow, temperature and composition are measured across process loads to build a yearly duration curve of waste heat.
quiz.explanation: 在製程的各種負載下量測廢氣的流量、溫度與成分，建立全年的餘熱延時曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Exhaust flow, temperature and composition are measured across process loads to build a yearly duration curve of waste heat. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可回收的餘熱與發電量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Recoverable waste heat and power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可回收的餘熱與發電量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Recoverable waste heat and power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在製程的各種負載下量測廢氣的流量、溫度與成分，建立全年的餘熱延時曲線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Exhaust flow, temperature and composition are measured across process loads to build a yearly duration curve of waste heat. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：餘熱發電要以全年的餘熱延時曲線決定容量，並確認廢氣冷卻後的溫度高於酸露點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Size waste-heat generation from the yearly duration curve, keeping cooled exhaust above the acid dew point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以製程滿載時的廢氣條件設計機組，實際上工廠有一半的時間在部分負載運轉，發電量遠低於預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A unit sized on exhaust at full process load generates far less than expected when the works runs part-loaded half the time. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在製程的各種負載下量測廢氣的流量、溫度與成分，建立全年的餘熱延時曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Exhaust flow, temperature and composition are measured across process loads to build a yearly duration curve of waste heat.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 餘熱發電要以全年的餘熱延時曲線決定容量，並確認廢氣冷卻後的溫度高於酸露點。
knowledge.textEn: Size waste-heat generation from the yearly duration curve, keeping cooled exhaust above the acid dew point.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ASME PTC 46 電廠整體性能試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ASME PTC 46 Overall Plant Performance. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「可回收的餘熱與發電量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Recoverable waste heat and power" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以製程滿載時的廢氣條件設計機組，實際上工廠有一半的時間在部分負載運轉，發電量遠低於預期。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。
optionsEn: A unit sized on exhaust at full process load generates far less than expected when the works runs part-loaded half the time.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%.
quiz.explanation: 以製程滿載時的廢氣條件設計機組，實際上工廠有一半的時間在部分負載運轉，發電量遠低於預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A unit sized on exhaust at full process load generates far less than expected when the works runs part-loaded half the time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可回收的餘熱與發電量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Recoverable waste heat and power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可回收的餘熱與發電量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Recoverable waste heat and power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以製程滿載時的廢氣條件設計機組，實際上工廠有一半的時間在部分負載運轉，發電量遠低於預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「有機朗肯循環餘熱發電」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: A unit sized on exhaust at full process load generates far less than expected when the works runs part-loaded half the time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：一座中型水泥窯的廢氣可以發兩 MW 上下，足以供應工廠自己一兩成的用電。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Exhaust of a medium cement kiln gives about two megawatts, a tenth or two of the works' own demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「工廠的廢氣是沒有價值的廢棄物。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Factory exhaust is worthless waste." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以製程滿載時的廢氣條件設計機組，實際上工廠有一半的時間在部分負載運轉，發電量遠低於預期。
knowledge.textEn: A unit sized on exhaust at full process load generates far less than expected when the works runs part-loaded half the time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" is correct?
options: 只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。
效率低的設備就是設計得不好。
熱機把熱轉成功的比例受熱力學第二定律限制，上限只取決於吸熱與排熱的絕對溫度。
optionsEn: With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%.
Plant of low efficiency is badly designed.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」如何決定「有機朗肯循環餘熱發電」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 熱機把熱轉成功的比例受熱力學第二定律限制，上限只取決於吸熱與排熱的絕對溫度。提高效率因此只有兩條路：提高熱源溫度，或降低排熱溫度。燃氣渦輪的進口溫度已超過 1,500 °C，遠高於葉片合金的熔點，靠的是氣膜冷卻與陶瓷熱障塗層；蒸汽循環則以超臨界參數與多次再熱提高平均吸熱溫度。實際效率與卡諾上限的差距，來自壓縮、膨脹、傳熱與燃燒等不可逆過程。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The share of heat a heat engine can turn into work is limited by the second law to a ceiling depending only on the absolute temperatures at which heat is taken in and rejected. Efficiency therefore improves only by raising source temperature or lowering rejection temperature. Gas-turbine inlet temperatures now exceed 1,500 °C, far above the melting point of blade alloys, thanks to film cooling and ceramic thermal-barrier coatings, while steam cycles raise mean heat-addition temperature with supercritical conditions and reheating. The gap between real efficiency and Carnot comes from irreversibility in compression, expansion, heat transfer and combustion. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：餘熱發電的效率通常為 10% 至 25%
steps.observationEn: Project file: Waste-heat generation is typically 10% to 25% efficient
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.question: 依「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的模型 η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h，以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h for "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling", which value is closest to the carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature?
quiz.explanation: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 30 °C、TIT = 350 °C，得 51.4 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 30 °C, TIT = 350 °C the result is 51.4 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 30 °C、TIT = 350 °C，得 51.4 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 TIT 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 30 °C, TIT = 350 °C the result is 51.4 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise TIT by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：TIT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 53.9 %（+5.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising TIT by 10% changes the result to 53.9 % (+5.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 51.4 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 TIT 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 51.4 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in TIT with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h；代入 Tc = 30 °C、TIT = 350 °C，得 51.4 %（以渦輪進口溫度與環境溫度計算的卡諾上限）。
knowledge.textEn: η_C = 1 − T_c / T_h; with Tc = 30 °C, TIT = 350 °C the result is 51.4 % (carnot ceiling from turbine inlet temperature and ambient temperature).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: TIT 增加 10% 時，結果變為 53.9 %（+5.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising TIT by 10% changes the result to 53.9 % (+5.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。
機組的出力就是銘牌上寫的那個數字。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance.
A unit's output is the figure on its nameplate.
quiz.explanation: 依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱源溫度與卡諾上限：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ASME PTC 46 做全廠性能試驗：量測燃料流量與熱值、淨出力與環境條件，修正到合約基準後求得淨效率，並與設計熱平衡比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run an overall plant performance test under ASME PTC 46: measure fuel flow and heating value, net output and ambient conditions, correct to contract reference conditions to obtain net efficiency, and compare with the design heat balance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：性能保證要載明基準環境條件、燃料成分與退化修正曲線，並在大修前後各做一次性能試驗以量化回復量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Performance guarantees should state reference ambient conditions, fuel composition and degradation-correction curves, with a test before and after each major overhaul to quantify recovery.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

效率低的設備就是設計得不好。
壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。

Plant of low efficiency is badly designed.
Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year.

quiz.explanationEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.titleEn: Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 壓縮機葉片積垢、渦輪葉尖間隙磨耗與進氣濾網壓降增加，使各部件效率下降，整廠效率每年退化零點幾個百分點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「有機朗肯循環餘熱發電」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Compressor fouling, turbine tip-clearance wear and rising inlet-filter pressure drop lower component efficiency, degrading plant efficiency by a few tenths of a percentage point each year. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Organic Rankine Cycle Waste Heat Recovery”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際效率與卡諾上限的差距，來自壓縮、膨脹、傳熱與燃燒等不可逆過程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The gap between real efficiency and Carnot comes from irreversibility in compression, expansion, heat transfer and combustion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要機器做得夠精密，熱機效率可以接近百分之百。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With precise enough machinery, heat-engine efficiency can approach 100%." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
